_meta.why: Generated once, human-reviewed, committed. A dunning email for a given failure code is the same class of output every time, so paying for inference on every invoice would be waste. Runtime fills the slots; no model is called on this path.
_meta.review: Edit this file directly and re-run the suite. Changes are code review, not prompt engineering.

diagnosis.card_expired: The card on file for {name} has expired, so the {plan} renewal couldn't be charged. This is the most recoverable kind of failure: the subscription is active and only needs a current card, so retrying the old one will keep failing until it's updated.
diagnosis.insufficient_funds: The latest {plan} charge for {name} was declined for insufficient funds, which is almost always a temporary timing issue rather than a churn signal. The card itself is valid, so spacing the retry to land after a likely top-up should recover the payment.
diagnosis.generic_decline: The {plan} payment for {name} hit a generic decline, meaning the issuer blocked it without a specific reason - often a temporary bank hold. It's a recoverable middle case: one well-timed retry plus a nudge to check with their bank usually clears it.

message.card_expired:
Hi {name}, we tried to renew your {plan} plan but the card we have on file has expired, so the latest payment didn't go through. There's nothing to worry about - your service is still running for now. Whenever you have a moment, just update your card and we'll handle the rest in one click. Reply here anytime if you'd like a hand.

Warmly,
The PayPilot Team
message.insufficient_funds:
Hi {name}, a quick heads-up: your most recent {plan} payment didn't clear, and it looks like a temporary funding hiccup rather than anything wrong with your card. Your account stays active, so there's nothing urgent to do. We'll automatically retry in a few days - and if it'd help, just reply and we can sort out timing or options together.

Thanks for being with us,
The PayPilot Team
message.generic_decline:
Hi {name}, we weren't able to process your {plan} renewal - the bank declined the charge without a specific reason, which usually points to a temporary hold on their side. Your service is still on, so nothing changes for now. It often helps to give your bank a quick check or try another card, and we'll retry shortly either way. Reach out anytime.

Best,
The PayPilot Team
